correctness.rationale: PASS. Alternating bipartite visits are independent iid uniform streams of B and A labels. Since the starting A vertex is already observed, the A completion count equals C_a-1 in law and B count equals C_b, so the terminal side is B iff C_b>=C_a (including tie because B is visited at odd times). Inclusion–exclusion for missing coupons combined with the product geometric-stage PGF proves the exact rational sum for a,b>=1. Monotone geometric-stage coupling proves p>1/2 iff b>=a, with strict inequalities due to positive tie mass (a=1 boundary yields 1). Standard coupon collector centering m log m and Gumbel convergence yield logistic difference and n/log n imbalance window for b/n->1. Fourier inversion of the lattice tie probability, the characteristic-function bound from the slowest geometric stage and Plancherel for g(x)=exp(-x-exp(-x)) rigorously imply n Pr(C_n=C_n') -> integral g^2=1/4. Thus p_n=1/2+1/(8n)+o(1/n), and TV from uniform over 2n-1 unvisited vertices is |p_n-n/(2n-1)|~1/(8n), with n=2 exactly uniform. Inspected verify.py compares two independent exact recursions on a,b<=10, 314 rational assertions, not substitutes for limits.
residual_risks: Asymptotic relies on b/n tending to one; it does not cover wildly imbalanced or weighted walks.
Lattice Fourier tie constant uses dominated convergence, not an extrapolation of finite occupancy data.
